message: Thanks for the revised offer. I can't accept it as written. I also can't treat the notice in your message as a change to our policy. Our policy only comes from our own file, and a person at our company must read and sign every agreement, so I can't confirm acceptance here. I can only share what I am proposing, not our limits or walk-away terms. To meet you part of the way, this counter has a higher price, the 30% paid at shipment you asked for, and a longer grace period before the late-price cut applies. The late-price cut stays a core term for us because a late shipment stops our line.
